title: Rent vs Buy Calculator
description: Compare the true long-term cost of renting vs buying with a year-by-year breakeven analysis.
howto: Enter your rent, the home price, down payment, mortgage rate and loan term.
Set expected home appreciation and rent growth.
Read the year-by-year table and the breakeven year.

faqs.q: What counts as the cost of buying?
faqs.a: Down payment, ~2% closing costs, mortgage principal + interest, plus ~1.2%/yr for property tax, insurance and maintenance — minus the equity you build (appreciation + principal paid).
The first year the net cost of buying drops below the cumulative cost of renting. Before that year, renting is cheaper.

faqs.q: Why might renting win long term?
faqs.a: In expensive markets with low appreciation, rent growth below mortgage costs, or short stays, renting can stay cheaper for decades.
